emergency_predicate.rule: fresh permitted attitude with abs(wrapped angle)>=1.20 or abs(angular speed)>=4.5; identical physical supervisor across all comparators; at most 48 ticks; no ordinary teacher fallback

excluded_claims: sealed outcomes before all six finals

bc.aim_loss: normalized aim MSE only when requested primary is true; never selected by future outcome
bc.burn_in: complete preceding physical episode prefix under current weights; no gradient; masks remain inside fixed windows
bc.data_selection: all eligible ordinary proposed controls including failed episodes and pulse abstention
bc.primary_positive_weight: training-only negatives / max(positives, 1), clipped to [1, 10]; only no-positive secondary has fixed weight 1

ppo.base: own seed BC-final frozen before residual initialization/updates; no authored runtime calls
ppo.burn_in: complete preceding physical episode prefix under current weights; residual and frozen base states independent
ppo.initial: exactly zero deterministic residual; fixed stochastic exploration
ppo.likelihood: joint five pre-transform Gaussian draws and two Bernoulli draws; no post-transform density claim
ppo.rollout_cutoff: fresh episode after each update; actual durations; valid final administrative cutoff bootstraps

seed_rules.ppo_host_seed: exact declared seed of selected teacher case; no new host-seed family

selection: whole BC family first if qualified; residual must pass own initial-gain gate; six final hashes precede every sealed outcome including authored/idle; no seed or checkpoint selection
